description: PAID, per call: search the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's published enforcement reports (food, drug and device recalls) by domain, classification, recalling firm, recall number, keyword and report date (give a firm, a recall number, a keyword or a since date). Returns up to 10 recall rows with the dates of the data and the FDA address for the full report. Remedy text is not included. You are not charged when nothing matches or when the data is out of date.

domain.description: Which enforcement report: food, drug or device.

firm.description: Words of the recalling firm's name.

keyword.description: Words to find in the firm, product and reason. Every word must appear.

recall_number.description: The FDA recall number exactly as published, for example F-0123-2026.

since.description: Report date on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: search_us_fda_recalls
